en.headline: 9 own commits plus 17 automated commits
en.summary: **9 own commits** landed in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, with no pull requests, issues, or reviews recorded. The work updated `AGENTS.md` with branch discipline, push-proxy and session-library query caveats, removed outdated assertions, and added root and worktree self-checks. Knowledge notes were revised to flag two unverified SenseNova details, document that Windows does not require WSL2, and explain multi-provider completion coexistence with 300ms debounce semantics. A `knowledge-ingest` command was added, and evaluation records were updated to log output session IDs, classify the octopus animation under `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, and move `octopus-bike` to `html-svg-2d-javascript/fusion-mv9kbj67`. The Iceman pelican cycling entry was added along with an analysis of `eval-comparison` failures and verification methods. Separately, **17 automated commits** by `github-actions[bot]` were recorded in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`.

zh.headline: 9 次本人提交，另有 17 次自动提交
zh.summary: `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 落地 **9 次本人提交**，未记录 pull request、issue 或 review。提交更新了 `AGENTS.md`，补充分支纪律、推送代理与会话库查询注意事项，移除过期断言，并加入根目录与工作树自检。知识文档标注了 SenseNova 速查中两处推测，补充 Windows 无需 WSL2 的实测纠正，并说明多 provider 补全并存规则与 300ms 防抖语义。新增了 `knowledge-ingest` 命令，评测登记表记录产出会话 id，章鱼动画归入 `deepseek-v4.1-flash`，并将 `octopus-bike` 移至 `html-svg-2d-javascript/fusion-mv9kbj67`。同时收录 Iceman 版鹈鹕骑车，并补充 `eval-comparison` 失效分析与验证方法。另外，`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 记录了 **17 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交**。
